svg.aria-label: I'm doing a master's degree, which is not the point at all. I code, build, read, write, and plenty of other stuff. Most of the time I have a thing for aesthetics—and how things feel to use. My dream job is to work on the intersection of design and development. If possible, I want to be a full-time open source contributor.
